findings.quote: with only two or three companions
findings.problem: Greek ἀλύων ἐφαίνετο δεύτερος καὶ τρίτος: he appeared as 'second and third', i.e. himself plus one or two others (one or two companions), not two or three companions.
findings.proposed_fix: with only one or two companions

units.note: Greek has an ellipsis after ὀνομασθείς (excerptor's join to the Polybius quotation); English reads on as continuous. Not a Polybian lacuna, left unflagged. 'knucklebones made from gazelle horn' for ἀστραγάλους δορκαδείους (gazelle knucklebones) is loose but outside the error classes.
Greek ends with a dash (excerpt breaks off); English ends with a full stop. Minor, not flagged.
